chapter.li: Verse2 Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: the first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, VerseEnd Verse3 Philip, and Bartholomew, Thomas, and Matthew the publican, James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus, VerseEnd Verse4 Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. VerseEnd

Verse5 These twelve Jesus sent forth and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and enter not into any city of the Samaritans, VerseEnd Verse6 but rather go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. VerseEnd Verse7 And as you go, preach, saying, The kingdom of Heaven is at hand. VerseEnd Verse8 Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils. Freely you have received, freely give. VerseEnd Verse9 Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses, VerseEnd Verse10 nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves, for the workman is worthy of his food. VerseEnd Verse11 And into whatever town or city you shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and there abide until you go from there. VerseEnd Verse12 And when you come into a house, salute it; VerseEnd Verse13 and if the house is worthy, let your peace come upon it; but if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you. VerseEnd Verse14 And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet VerseEnd Verse15 for a testimony against them. And truly I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city. VerseEnd

Verse16 Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be therefore wise servants and as harmless as doves. VerseEnd Verse17 But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues, VerseEnd Verse18 and you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles. VerseEnd Verse19 But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak, for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak; VerseEnd Verse20 for it is not you that speaks, but the spirit of your Father which speaks in you. VerseEnd

Verse21 And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child. And the children shall rise up against their parents and cause them to be put to death. VerseEnd Verse22 And you shall be hated of all the world for my name’s sake, but he that endures to the end shall be saved. VerseEnd Verse23 But when they persecute you in one city, flee into another; for truly I say unto you, you shall not have gone over the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come. VerseEnd

Verse24 Remember, the disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord. VerseEnd Verse25 It is enough that the disciple be as his master and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household? VerseEnd Verse26 Fear them not, therefore, for there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, and hidden that shall not be known. VerseEnd Verse27 What I tell you in darkness, speak in light. And what you hear in the ear, preach upon the housetops. VerseEnd

Verse28 And fear not them who are able to kill the body but are not able to kill the soul. But rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell. VerseEnd Verse29 Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? And one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father VerseEnd Verse30 knowing it. And the very hairs of your head are all numbered. VerseEnd Verse31 Fear not, therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows. VerseEnd Verse32 Whoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father who is in Heaven; VerseEnd Verse33 but whoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in Heaven. VerseEnd

Verse34 Think not that I have come to send peace on earth. I came not to send peace, but a sword; VerseEnd Verse35 for I have come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. VerseEnd Verse36 And a man’s foes will be they of his own household. VerseEnd Verse37 He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me, and he who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me, VerseEnd Verse38 and he who takes not his cross and follow after me is not worthy of me. VerseEnd Verse39 He who seeks to save his life shall lose it, and he who loses his life for my sake shall find it. VerseEnd

Verse40 He who receives you, receives me. And he who receives me, receives him who sent me. VerseEnd Verse41 He that receives a prophet, in the name of a prophet, shall receive a prophet’s reward. And he that receives a righteous man, in the name of a righteous man, shall receive a righteous man’s reward. VerseEnd Verse42 And whoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, truly I say unto you, he shall by no means lose his reward. VerseEnd
